in_arabic.name: رقيه
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مؤنث يعني الرفعة و العلو في الخُلُق و المكانة
in_arabic.long_meaning: رقيه من أسماء البنات في الإسلام، مشتقة من الفعل رَقِيَ يَرقَى رُقِيّاً، وتعني الارتفاع في المكانة و الرفعة في الخُلُق. ورد اسم رقيه في السنة النبوية، حيث كانت رقيه بنت النبي محمد صلى الله عليه و سلم.

in_pashto.name: رقيه
in_pashto.meaning: رقيه د لوړوالي او عزت معنا لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: رقيه د اسلامي نومونو څخه يو دی، چي د (رَقِيَ) کلمې څخه اخيستل شوی دی. دا نوم د لوړوالي او عزت معنی لري. رقيه د پيغمبر محمد صلی الله عليه وسلم د لور نوم هم دی.

data.cultural_impact: The name Ruqaiya in Arabic originates from the Arabic word "RaqAAyah", which means "a thirst quencher or something that refreshes and soothes" (Larousse Dictionary of First Names). In Islamic culture, this name is cherished for its symbolism of hospitality and generosity. It is an honorable title for a woman who is known for her kindness, compassion, and attentiveness towards others' needs and comfort. In this way, the name Ruqaiya reflects the moral values of Islam such as caring for the welfare of others and recognizing the importance of community and solidarity.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Ruqaiya can be seen as a reminder of the importance of fulfilling the needs of others in seeking nearness to Allah (SWT). In the sacred scripture of Islam, the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) said, "None of you will enter Paradise until he is reconciled with three, and I am the fourth: (1) A man with whom you are connected by mutual kindness; (2) a relative whom you maintain [as a relation]; and (3) a creditor to whom you repay debt" (Narrated by An-Nufayth ibn Al-Harith, reported in Sunan At-Tirmidhi, Saleh Al-Hanafi, and Sahih Ibn Hibban). This hadith indicates the significance of fulfilling the needs of others not only as a social responsibility but also as a means of drawing closer to Allah (SWT) in this world and attaining blessings in the Hereafter. Therefore, the name Ruqaiya, encompassing the essence of being a thirst quencher, offers an inspiration for women to strive to be kind, compassionate, and generous, thus earning Allah's pleasure and respect in the spiritual realm.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Quencher of Thirst" symbolizes She who quenches the thirst of others. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Ruqaiya serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of quencher of thirst.
